description: This file defines classes and main function for a WiFi data provider module, including classes for Adapter, Interface, Router, EndPoint, and WiFi objects, and registers these providers with a host.

classes.name: AdapterObject
classes.description: Represents a WiFi Adapter with an alias, inherits from dmProvider.

classes.name: InterfaceObject
classes.description: Represents a WiFi Interface with an alias, inherits from dmProvider.

classes.name: RouterObject
classes.description: Represents a WiFi Router with a name, inherits from dmProvider.

classes.name: EndPointObject
classes.description: Represents a WiFi EndPoint with properties like alias, SSID, security, status, supports transactions.

classes.name: WiFiObject
classes.description: Represents the WiFi device, provides endpoints and noise level info, inherits from dmProvider.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main function initializes the WiFi provider, registers endpoints, adapters, interfaces, router, and runs indefinitely.
